d:
Did you know India has many luxury trains that make you feel like you're travelling inside a 5-star hotel? This journey took me on a 6D/5N journey while exploring the gems of South India!
I spent 6 days on the Golden Chariot exploring palaces, temples, backwaters, and everything in between. From Mysore to Kerala, this felt like a dream I didn’t want to wake up from!
There were the locations covered during my itinerary called "The Jewels of South India"
• Bangalore
• Mysuru
• Mahabalipuram
• Thanjavur
• Chettinad
